text.name: Eurozone Crisis
text.rules: Record "troika". LIO chooses: Bail out Greece? If yes, LIO spends 1 point on actions, then until the end of this turn, each time LIO spends points, it spends 1 fewer, never below 1; if no, record "port sold", then SAE spends 2 points on one action.
text.history: Greece agreed its first €110 billion bailout from eurozone countries and the IMF on 3 May 2010; in 2016 China's COSCO bought a 67 per cent stake in the Piraeus Port Authority.
